sticker_location: On the back of the alarm, with the date it was made.

problems.title: Chirping every minute
symptoms: It beeps once in a while

plan.diagnosis: One short chirp every 30 to 60 seconds means the battery is low. A fresh battery and a test stops it. Alarms older than 10 years chirp at the end of their life and need replacing.
replacement_parts: 9-volt battery (or the type on the label)
safety: Never leave the alarm without a battery; replace it today.

steps.instruction: Stand on something steady under it
details: Use a step stool, not a wobbly chair.
Ask someone to hold it if you can.
steps.check: You can reach the alarm comfortably.

steps.instruction: Twist the alarm left and pull it down
details: Turn it about an eighth of a turn.
Some are wired: unclip the plug on the back.
steps.check: The alarm is off the ceiling in your hand.

details: Most take a 9-volt; check the label on the back.
Check the date on the back: older than 10 years? Replace the whole alarm.
steps.check: The new battery sits in with + and − matching the marks.

steps.instruction: Twist it back onto the ceiling
steps.check: It's locked flat against the ceiling.

steps.instruction: Press and hold the test button
steps.check: It sounds a loud alarm, then stops.

rig_beats.caption: Line it up on the plate

problems.title: Goes off when I cook
symptoms: The smoke alarm goes off when I cook
It goes off for no reason

plan.diagnosis: Dust in the vents or an alarm too close to the stove or bathroom sets it off. Silence it, blow the dust out, and keep it at least 10 feet from the stove.
tools: Vacuum brush or can of air
safety: Never take the battery out to stop false alarms.

steps.instruction: If there's any real smoke or fire, get everyone out
details: Call 911 from outside if you see flames or smell burning you can't explain.
steps.check: You've checked: it's only cooking smoke or steam.

steps.instruction: Press the button to hush it
details: Open a window and fan the smoke away.
steps.check: It goes quiet for a few minutes.

steps.instruction: Take it down and blow the dust out
details: Use a vacuum brush or a can of air around the slots.

steps.instruction: Put it back and test it
details: If it's within 10 feet of the stove, a photoelectric alarm or moving it helps.
steps.check: It locks on and sounds when tested.

rig_beats.caption: Line it up on the plate

problems.title: Doesn't beep when tested
symptoms: Nothing happens when I press test
It's silent when I test it

plan.diagnosis: A silent test usually means a dead or missing battery, or the alarm is past its 10-year life. A fresh battery tells you which.
replacement_parts: A new smoke alarm if it's over 10 years old

steps.instruction: Put in a brand new battery
details: Check the date on the back while it's down.
steps.check: A new battery is in, facing the right way.

details: Still silent, or older than 10 years: replace the alarm today.

rig_beats.caption: Line it up on the plate
